## Summary

Describe the behavior changed and why it belongs in this repository.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] `python tools/public_release_guard.py --root .`
- [ ] Reference parity or numerical tolerances are documented where applicable.
- [ ] Benchmark changes record warm-up, synchronization, shapes, dtype, and environment.

## Provenance and release safety

- [ ] Adapted code identifies its source URL, immutable revision, and license.
- [ ] No model files, audio, datasets, access material, profiler captures, or generated results are included.
- [ ] Claims are limited to tests and measurements attached to this change.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration contain no host-specific absolute paths.
